Manifest.Name: 可能是按键统一优化 / Probably Unified Hotkeys
Manifest.Author: 太湖白1231
Manifest.Description:
将《深空当铺》原版与工坊模组的快捷键、常规设置合并至官方 ESC「选项」页。
【操作说明】 • 按 ESC 打开「选项」；点击按键录入（支持鼠标右键与侧键），按 Esc 设为「无」，左键取消。 • 修改后点击底部「应用」保存；展开本模组卡片内置「方案一/二/三」与剪贴板导入导出。
【主要功能】 • 统一视图：按分区折叠卡片，支持原版样式与一键「恢复默认」。 • 按键增强：支持 Shift / Ctrl / Alt 组合键、鼠标右键与侧键（Mouse1~6）及空键解绑（按 Esc 设为「无」）。 • 快速检索：支持简繁中英、多音字与拼音搜索，自带 [!] 冲突集中筛选。 • 方案快照：展开本模组卡片提供 3 套本地预设槽位与剪贴板导入导出。 • 智能整理：模组标题中文化显示，支持顶部「模组排查」一键复制汇总。 • 流畅响应：选项开窗单帧响应，改造件封面本地秒开防串图，退游与返回主菜单加速。
---
Merges vanilla and workshop mod hotkeys and settings into the official ESC "Options" menu.
[Usage] • Press ESC to open "Options"; click any key to rebind (supports Right Click and side buttons), press Esc to clear ("None"), left click to cancel. • Click "Apply" at the bottom to save; expand this mod card for Preset Slots 1/2/3 and clipboard import/export.
[Features] • Unified View: Collapsible cards matching native style with per-section "Reset to Default". • Enhanced Keybinds: Supports Shift / Ctrl / Alt combos, mouse right click and side buttons (Mouse1~6), and unbinding to "None". • Fast Search: Search via Chinese (Simp/Trad), Polyphone Pinyin, or English with [!] conflict filter. • Profile Snapshots: Expand mod card for 3 local preset slots and 1-click clipboard import/export. • Smart Organizing: Localized mod section titles and top diagnostics bar with 1-click summary copy. • Smooth Performance: Single-frame Options opening, instant mod cover loading without mismatched icons, and fast quit/main menu return.
